lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs posterior to the fifth gill slit are organized into five distinct vertical columns. The spatial distribution transitions from a high-density, disordered cluster in the post-cephalic region to a more regular, wide-spaced grid along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs. These intersections create a nodal grid where the highest luminance maxima are centered within the vertical bands and bounded horizontally by the longitudinal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper two-thirds of the flank. They exhibit a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep-value shadows on the inferior edge, maintaining a trajectory parallel to the horizontal body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin and trailing the posterior flank region.
